---
title: "About"
---

This site presents a structured view of my active research notebook.

## Purpose

- Share evolving research ideas with my professor
- Keep a transparent trail from question -> model -> experiment
- Separate exploratory thinking from finalized claims

## What this is (and is not)

- **Is**: a working space for hypotheses, conceptual links, and direction-setting
- **Is not**: a final thesis document or publication-ready material

## Updating Process

I write and update source notes in `.qmd` on the `master` branch.
The website is generated automatically from those notes after each push.
